articles.title_en: Price Transparency, Media, and Informative Advertising
articles.title_cn: 价格透明度、媒体与信息性广告
articles.abstract_en: We study the effects of a price transparency regulation in Israeli supermarkets. Using price data collected before and after the regulation and a difference-in-difference research design, we show that price levels and price dispersion declined significantly after the regulation. Chains also began setting identical prices in all stores. We use Robert and Stahl (1993) to interpret our findings, showing that low-priced chains extensively used price advertising after prices became transparent. These chains referenced price-comparison surveys conducted by the media to induce credibility for ads. Our findings highlight the importance of price transparency and the procompetitive role of informative advertising. (JEL D22, D83, L11, L81, L82, L88, M37)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了以色列超市价格透明度监管的影响。利用监管前后收集的价格数据和双重差分研究设计，我们表明监管后价格水平和价格离散度显著下降。连锁店也开始在所有门店设定相同的价格。我们使用Robert和Stahl（1993）来解释我们的发现，表明低价连锁店在价格变得透明后广泛使用价格广告。这些连锁店引用媒体进行的价格比较调查以增强广告的可信度。我们的发现强调了价格透明度的重要性以及信息性广告的促进竞争作用。（JEL D22, D83, L11, L81, L82, L88, M37）

articles.title_en: Compatibility Choices, Switching Costs, and Data Portability
articles.title_cn: 兼容性选择、转换成本与数据可携性
articles.abstract_en: We study mix-and-match compatibility choices of firms selling complementary products in a dynamic setting. Contrary to what happens in a static setting where symmetric firms choose compatibility (Matutes and Regibeau 1988), when switching costs are high and firms make price discrimination based on past purchases, symmetric firms choose incompatibility to soften future competition if the discount factor is large, which harms consumers. Interoperability increases consumer surplus at least for high switching costs. Data portability, by reducing switching costs, induces the firms to choose compatibility more often but, given a compatibility regime, benefits consumers only if a nonnegative pricing constraint binds. (JEL D11, D21, D43, D82, L86)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在动态环境中销售互补产品的企业的混合搭配兼容性选择。与静态环境中对称企业选择兼容性的情况（Matutes和Regibeau 1988）相反，当转换成本较高且企业基于过去的购买行为进行价格歧视时，如果贴现因子较大，对称企业会选择不兼容以缓和未来竞争，这损害了消费者利益。互操作性至少在高转换成本下增加了消费者剩余。数据可携性通过降低转换成本，促使企业更频繁地选择兼容性，但在给定的兼容性制度下，只有在非负定价约束起作用时才对消费者有利。（JEL D11, D21, D43, D82, L86）

articles.title_en: Alert the Inert? Switching Costs and Limited Awareness in Retail Electricity Markets
articles.title_cn: 唤醒惰性？零售电力市场中的转换成本与有限认知
articles.abstract_en: We quantify how switching costs and limited awareness affect consumer inertia in liberalized retail electricity markets by developing and estimating a structural demand model using a novel dataset on electricity contract choices in Belgium. Our data allow us to disentangle different sources of inertia by using a rich combination of macromoments and micromoments. We find that consumers perceive contracts as differentiated and both limited awareness and switching costs hinder efficient choices. Our counterfactuals reveal substantial welfare gains from alleviating both frictions, in particular switching costs, and that a well-regulated monopoly can generate similar consumer surplus as the current deregulated market. (JEL D12, D83, L13, L43, L94, L98)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过开发并估计一个结构需求模型，利用比利时电力合同选择的新数据集，量化了转换成本和有限认知如何影响自由化零售电力市场中的消费者惰性。我们的数据使我们能够通过宏观时刻和微观时刻的丰富组合来区分惰性的不同来源。我们发现消费者认为合同是有差异的，并且有限认知和转换成本都阻碍了有效选择。我们的反事实分析揭示了缓解这两种摩擦（尤其是转换成本）所带来的巨大福利收益，并且一个监管良好的垄断企业可以产生与当前放松管制市场相似的消费者剩余。（JEL D12, D83, L13, L43, L94, L98）

articles.title_en: Product Quality and Consumer Search
articles.title_cn: 产品质量与消费者搜索
articles.abstract_en: An increase in quality shifts up the distribution of match utilities offered by firms and makes consumers pickier. The number of products that consumers inspect does not necessarily increase in quality. Higher search costs may lead to less quality investment, and the equilibrium price may decrease. If the equilibrium is inefficient, it is because of the inadequacy of quality investment. The market level of quality investment is excessive (insufficient) and consumers are too (little) picky from the point of view of welfare maximization if and only if a rise in quality results in consumers inspecting a higher (lower) number of products. (JEL D11, D21, D83, G31, L15)
articles.abstract_cn: 质量的提高会使企业提供的匹配效用的分布上移，并使消费者变得更加挑剔。消费者检查的产品数量不一定随质量提高而增加。较高的搜索成本可能导致较低的质量投资，均衡价格可能下降。如果均衡是无效率的，那是因为质量投资不足。从福利最大化的角度看，当且仅当质量提高导致消费者检查更多（更少）的产品时，市场质量投资水平是过度（不足）的，消费者过于（不够）挑剔。（JEL D11, D21, D83, G31, L15）

articles.title_en: Primary-Market Auctions for Event Tickets: Eliminating the Rents of “Bob the Broker”?
articles.title_cn: 活动门票的一级市场拍卖：消除“黄牛鲍勃”的租金？
articles.abstract_en: Economists have long been puzzled by event-ticket underpricing: underpricing reduces revenue for the performer and encourages socially wasteful rent-seeking by ticket brokers. What about using an auction? This paper studies the introduction of auctions into this market by Ticketmaster in the mid-2000s. By combining primary-market auction data from Ticketmaster with secondary-market resale value data from eBay, we show that Ticketmaster’s auctions “worked”: they substantially improved price discovery, roughly doubled performer revenues, and, on average, nearly eliminated the potential arbitrage profits associated with underpriced tickets. We conclude by discussing why, nevertheless, the auctions failed to take off. (JEL D44, D47, L82)
articles.abstract_cn: 经济学家长期以来对活动门票定价偏低感到困惑：定价偏低降低了表演者的收入，并鼓励了票务黄牛进行社会浪费的寻租行为。那么使用拍卖会怎样呢？本文研究了Ticketmaster在2000年代中期将拍卖引入这一市场的情况。通过将Ticketmaster的一级市场拍卖数据与eBay的二级市场转售价值数据相结合，我们表明Ticketmaster的拍卖“奏效了”：它们显著改善了价格发现，大致使表演者收入翻倍，并且平均而言，几乎消除了与定价偏低门票相关的潜在套利利润。最后，我们讨论了为什么尽管如此，拍卖未能普及。（JEL D44, D47, L82）

articles.title_en: Misbehavior in Common Value Auctions: Bidding Rings and Shills
articles.title_cn: 共同价值拍卖中的不当行为：竞标联盟与托儿
articles.abstract_en: We characterize the optimal misbehavior by bidding rings or an auctioneer in the ascending English auction with common values. We also show, in an extended game, that in equilibrium potential members join and truthfully reveal their signals. Under a separability assumption, behavior does not change if nonring bidders are informed about the ring’s existence. In general, misbehavior in dynamic settings is more profitable than in outcome-equivalent static settings. However, under a stronger separability assumption, the ring can do no better in the dynamic English format than in the outcome-equivalent, static Sophi format. (JEL D44, D82)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们刻画了在具有共同价值的升序英式拍卖中，竞标联盟或拍卖师的最优不当行为。我们还证明，在扩展博弈中，均衡状态下潜在成员会加入并如实透露其信号。在可分离性假设下，如果非联盟竞标者知晓联盟的存在，行为不会改变。一般而言，动态环境中的不当行为比结果等价的静态环境中更有利可图。然而，在更强的可分离性假设下，联盟在动态英式拍卖中的表现不会优于结果等价的静态Sophi拍卖。（JEL D44, D82）

articles.title_en: Contest Design with Stochastic Performance
articles.title_cn: 随机绩效下的竞赛设计
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies optimal contest design in contests with noisy performance. Here, contest design is a team moral hazard problem that endogenizes the assignment rule that maps performance profiles into winning probabilities. The optimal design features endogenous standards for eligibility, and the number of prizes that are awarded may be stochastic. Generally, one group of agents is identified as “first claimants” of prizes, contingent on performance exceeding a threshold of excellence. However, which group wins prizes more often depends on the designer’s objective function and the performance technologies. Finally, the approach derives endogenous, microfounded, and fully optimal contest success functions. (JEL D44, D82)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了在具有噪声绩效的竞赛中的最优竞赛设计。在此，竞赛设计是一个团队道德风险问题，它将绩效概况映射到获胜概率的分配规则内生化。最优设计具有内生性的资格标准，且授予的奖品数量可能是随机的。通常，一组代理人被认定为奖品的“第一索取者”，取决于绩效是否超过卓越阈值。然而，哪一组更频繁地赢得奖品取决于设计者的目标函数和绩效技术。最后，该方法推导出内生的、基于微观基础的、完全最优的竞赛成功函数。（JEL D44, D82）

articles.title_en: Two-Stage Contests with Private Information
articles.title_cn: 两阶段私人信息竞赛
articles.abstract_en: In perfectly discriminating contests with private information, low-ability contestants prefer to appear strong, while high-ability contestants prefer to appear weak. In a two-stage contest, this leads to a unique symmetric equilibrium with partial pooling in the first stage. A higher output in the first contest leads to a weakly higher belief about the contestant’s ability entering the second contest. We characterize this unique equilibrium when cost of effort is linear and show how the prize allocation and type distribution impact contestants’ expected output, payoffs, and the probability of surprise victories. (JEL D44, D82, D83)
articles.abstract_cn: 在具有私人信息的完全歧视性竞赛中，低能力参赛者倾向于表现强大，而高能力参赛者倾向于表现弱小。在两阶段竞赛中，这导致第一阶段存在部分混同的唯一对称均衡。第一次竞赛中的更高产出导致进入第二次竞赛时对参赛者能力的信念弱更高。我们刻画了当努力成本为线性时的这一唯一均衡，并展示了奖金分配和类型分布如何影响参赛者的预期产出、收益以及意外胜利的概率。（JEL D44, D82, D83）

articles.title_en: A Theory of Stability in Matching with Incomplete Information
articles.title_cn: 不完全信息匹配中的稳定性理论
articles.abstract_en: We provide a framework for studying two-sided matching markets with incomplete information. The framework accommodates two-sided incomplete information as well as heterogeneous information among the agents. We propose a notion called stability for a market state, which, based upon agents’ information structure, requires (i) individual rationality, (ii) no blocking, and (iii) information stability. The novelty of our stability notion lies in how the agents evaluate a blocking prospect in the presence of general two-sided incomplete information. We show that a stable state exists; moreover, if a state is stable, then coarsening agents’ information leads to another stable state. (JEL C78, D83)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提供了一个研究具有不完全信息的双边匹配市场的框架。该框架既适应双边不完全信息，也适应代理人之间的异质信息。我们提出了一个称为市场状态稳定性的概念，基于代理人的信息结构，要求（i）个体理性，（ii）无阻塞，以及（iii）信息稳定性。我们稳定性概念的新颖之处在于，在存在一般双边不完全信息的情况下，代理人如何评估阻塞前景。我们证明了稳定状态的存在；此外，如果一个状态是稳定的，那么对代理人信息进行粗化会导致另一个稳定状态。（JEL C78, D83）

articles.title_en: An Information Theory of Efficient Differential Treatment
articles.title_cn: 有效差别待遇的信息理论
articles.abstract_en: When are differential treatment policies—such as preferential treatment, affirmative action, and gender equity policies—justified by efficiency concerns? I propose a nonparametric assignment model where a policymaker assigns agents to different treatments or positions to maximize total surplus, based on the agents’ characteristics and noisy information about their types. I provide necessary and sufficient conditions on the agents’ signal structures, which characterize whether surplus maximization requires differential treatment or not, and study how the bias and informativeness of signal structures determine the efficiency implications of differential treatment. I examine implications of this model for inequality, decentralization, and empirical work. (JEL D63, D82, D83, I23, I24, J71)
articles.abstract_cn: 差别待遇政策——如优惠待遇、平权行动和性别平等政策——何时因效率考虑而合理？我提出了一个非参数分配模型，其中政策制定者根据代理人的特征及其类型的噪声信息，将代理人分配到不同的待遇或职位以最大化总剩余。我提供了关于代理人信号结构的必要且充分条件，这些条件刻画了剩余最大化是否需要差别待遇，并研究了信号结构的偏差和信息量如何决定差别待遇的效率含义。我考察了该模型对不平等、分权化和实证工作的启示。（JEL D63, D82, D83, I23, I24, J71）

articles.title_en: Dynamic Information Design under Constrained Communication Rules
articles.title_cn: 受约束沟通规则下的动态信息设计
articles.abstract_en: An information designer wishes to persuade agents to invest in a project of unknown quality. To do so, she must induce investment and collect feedback from these investments. Motivated by data regulations and simplicity concerns, our designer faces communication constraints. These constraints hinder her without benefiting the agents: they impose an upper bound on the induced belief spread, limiting persuasion. Nevertheless, two-rating systems (direct recommendations) are the optimal design when experimentation is needed to generate information and approximate the designer’s first-best payoff for specific feedback structures. When the designer has altruistic motives, constrained rules significantly decrease welfare. (JEL D64, D82, D83)
articles.abstract_cn: 一位信息设计者希望说服代理人投资于一个质量未知的项目。为此，她必须诱导投资并从这些投资中收集反馈。出于数据监管和简洁性的考虑，我们的设计者面临沟通约束。这些约束阻碍了她而不利于代理人：它们对诱导信念的扩散施加了上限，限制了说服力。然而，当需要实验来生成信息并为特定反馈结构近似设计者的最优收益时，两级评级系统（直接推荐）是最优设计。当设计者具有利他动机时，受约束的规则会显著降低福利。（JEL D64, D82, D83）

articles.title_en: Sequential Learning
articles.title_cn: 序贯学习
articles.abstract_en: We develop a model in which two players sequentially and publicly examine a project. In our model the player who moves first can fabricate evidence to influence the second mover, which creates a moral hazard problem. We find that early strategic uncertainty can mitigate this problem. In particular, for intermediate prior beliefs about the project’s quality, the Pareto-dominant equilibrium is in mixed strategies and consists of an early stage in which evidence may be fabricated and a later stage in which evidence is always authentic. Our findings shed light on the dynamics of R&D, quality assurance, and drug approval. (JEL D82, D83, L15)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个模型，其中两个参与者序贯且公开地审查一个项目。在我们的模型中，先行动者可以伪造证据以影响后行动者，这产生了道德风险问题。我们发现，早期的战略不确定性可以缓解这一问题。特别是，对于关于项目质量的中等先验信念，帕累托占优均衡是混合策略均衡，包括一个可能伪造证据的早期阶段和一个证据始终真实的后期阶段。我们的发现揭示了研发、质量保证和药物批准的动态。(JEL D82, D83, L15)

articles.title_en: When Is a Contrarian Adviser Optimal?
articles.title_cn: 何时逆势顾问是最优的？
articles.abstract_en: We compare contrarian to conformist advice, a contrarian expert being one whose preference bias is against the decision-maker’s prior optimal decision. Optimality of an expert depends on characteristics of prior information and learning. If either the expert is fully informed or fine information can be acquired cheaply, then for symmetric distributions F of the state, a conformist (contrarian) is superior if F is single peaked (bimodal). If only coarse information can be acquired, then a contrarian acquires more on average and hence is superior. If information is verifiable, a contrarian has less incentive to hide unfavorable evidence and again is superior. (JEL D72, D82, D83, G34, H71, I12, L94)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们比较了逆势建议与顺势建议，逆势专家是指其偏好偏差与决策者先验最优决策相反的专家。专家的最优性取决于先验信息和学习的特点。如果专家完全知情或者可以廉价获取精细信息，那么对于状态的对称分布F，如果F是单峰的（双峰的），则顺势（逆势）顾问更优。如果只能获取粗略信息，则逆势顾问平均获取更多信息，因此更优。如果信息是可验证的，则逆势顾问隐藏不利证据的激励较小，同样更优。（JEL D72, D82, D83, G34, H71, I12, L94）

articles.title_en: Debunking Rumors in Networks
articles.title_cn: 揭穿网络中的谣言
articles.abstract_en: We study the diffusion of a true and a false message (the rumor) in a social network. Upon hearing a message, individuals may believe it, disbelieve it, or debunk it through costly verification. Whenever the truth survives in steady state, so does the rumor. Communication intensity in itself is irrelevant for relative rumor prevalence, and the effect of homophily depends on the exact verification process and equilibrium verification rates. Our model highlights that successful policies in the fight against rumors increase individuals’ incentives to verify. (JEL D83, D85, L82, Z13)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究真实信息和虚假信息（谣言）在社交网络中的传播。听到信息后，个体可能相信、不相信或通过昂贵的信息核实来揭穿它。只要真相在稳态下存续，谣言也会存续。沟通强度本身与谣言的相对流行度无关，而同质性的影响取决于具体的核实过程和均衡核实率。我们的模型强调，打击谣言的成功政策会增加个体核实的激励。（JEL D83, D85, L82, Z13）

articles.title_en: Censorship and Reputation
articles.title_cn: 审查与声誉
articles.abstract_en: I study how a firm manages its reputation by both investing in the quality of its product and censoring, hiding bad news from consumers. Without censorship, the threat of bad news provides strong incentives for investment. I highlight discontinuities in the firm’s maximum equilibrium payoff that censorship creates. When censorship is inexpensive, the firm never invests and a patient firm’s payoffs approach the lowest possible. In contrast, when censorship is moderately expensive, there exist equilibria where product quality is persistently high and payoffs approach the first-best, which can exceed the maximum equilibrium payoff if it was unable to censor. (JEL D21, D82, D83, G31, G32, L15)
articles.abstract_cn: 我研究企业如何通过投资于产品质量和审查（即向消费者隐藏坏消息）来管理其声誉。在没有审查的情况下，坏消息的威胁为投资提供了强有力的激励。我强调了审查给企业最大均衡收益带来的不连续性。当审查成本低廉时，企业从不投资，耐心企业的收益接近最低可能水平。相反，当审查成本适中时，存在产品质量持续高且收益接近最优的均衡，这可能超过无法审查时的最大均衡收益。（JEL D21, D82, D83, G31, G32, L15）

articles.title_en: Togetherness in the Household
articles.title_cn: 家庭中的共处
articles.abstract_en: Spending time with a spouse is a major gain from marriage. We extend the classical collective model of the household to allow for togetherness between spouses. Togetherness takes the form of joint leisure and joint care for children. Using revealed preference conditions and Dutch data over the years 2009–2012, we find that households are willing to pay €1.20 per hour—10 percent of the average wage—to convert private leisure to joint leisure and €2.10 per hour to convert private childcare to joint childcare. Our results suggest togetherness is an important component of household time use despite being overlooked in the economics literature. (JEL D12, D13, J12, J13, J16, J22)
articles.abstract_cn: 与配偶共度时光是婚姻的一大收益。我们将经典的家庭集体模型扩展，允许配偶之间的共处。共处表现为共同休闲和共同照顾孩子。利用显示性偏好条件和荷兰2009-2012年的数据，我们发现家庭愿意为将私人休闲转换为共同休闲支付每小时1.20欧元——占平均工资的10%——以及为将私人育儿转换为共同育儿支付每小时2.10欧元。我们的结果表明，尽管共处在经济学文献中被忽视，但它是家庭时间使用的重要组成部分。(JEL D12, D13, J12, J13, J16, J22)

articles.title_en: Ten Isn’t Large! Group Size and Coordination in a Large-Scale Experiment
articles.title_cn: 十并不大！大规模实验中的群体规模与协调
articles.abstract_en: We provide experimental evidence on coordination within large groups that could proxy the atomistic nature of real-world markets. We use a bank run game where the two pure-strategy equilibria can be ranked by payoff and risk dominance and a sequence of public announcements introduces stochastic sunspot equilibria. We find systematic group size effects that theory fails to predict. When the payoff-dominant strategy is risky enough, the behavior of small groups is uninformative of the behavior in large groups: unlike smaller groups of size ten, larger groups exclusively coordinate on the Pareto-inferior strategy and never coordinate on sunspots. (JEL C92, D83, D91, G21)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提供了关于大群体内协调的实验证据，这些群体可以代表现实世界市场的原子性质。我们使用一个银行挤兑博弈，其中两个纯策略均衡可以按支付和风险优势排序，一系列公开公告引入了随机太阳黑子均衡。我们发现了理论无法预测的系统性群体规模效应。当支付占优策略足够有风险时，小群体的行为无法反映大群体的行为：与规模为十的较小群体不同，较大群体完全协调于帕累托劣势策略，并且从不协调于太阳黑子。（JEL C92, D83, D91, G21）

articles.title_en: The Effects of Time Preferences on Cooperation: Experimental Evidence from Infinitely Repeated Games
articles.title_cn: 时间偏好对合作的影响：来自无限重复博弈的实验证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies the effects of time preferences on cooperation in an infinitely repeated prisoner’s dilemma game experiment. Subjects play repeated games in the lab, all decisions at once, but stage game payoffs are paid over an extended period of time. Changing the time window of stage game payoffs (weekly or monthly) varies discount factors, and a delay for the first-stage game payoffs eliminates/weakens present bias. First, subjects with weekly payments cooperate more than subjects with monthly payments—higher discount factors promote greater cooperation. Second, the rate of cooperation is higher when there is a delay—present bias reduces cooperation. (JEL C72, C73, D91)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文通过无限重复囚徒困境博弈实验研究时间偏好对合作的影响。受试者在实验室中进行重复博弈，所有决策一次性做出，但阶段博弈收益在较长时间内分期支付。改变阶段博弈收益的时间窗口（每周或每月）会改变贴现因子，而第一阶段博弈收益的延迟支付则消除或削弱了现时偏误。首先，每周支付的受试者比每月支付的受试者合作更多——更高的贴现因子促进更多合作。其次，存在延迟时合作率更高——现时偏误降低合作。（JEL C72, C73, D91）

articles.title_en: Implications of Unequal Discounting in Dynamic Contracting
articles.title_cn: 动态契约中不等贴现的含义
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies a canonical dynamic screening problem where the agent has Markovian private information and limited commitment and the principal and the agent have different discount factors. Unequal discounting captures unequal access to capital markets. In comparison to standard models of dynamic mechanism design, the principal no longer finds it optimal to maximally back-load the agent’s information rents: a new force of inter-temporal cost of incentive provision pushes toward front-loading agents’ payoffs. The optimal contract settles into a cycle with infinite memory. The introduction of unequal discounting renders the standard relaxed-problem approach invalid for certain parameters. A simple and approximately optimal contract is then provided. (JEL D21, D61, D82, D86, L14)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了一个典型的动态筛选问题，其中代理人具有马尔可夫私人信息和有限承诺，且委托人与代理人具有不同的贴现因子。不等贴现反映了进入资本市场的机会不平等。与标准动态机制设计模型相比，委托人不再认为最大化地延迟代理人的信息租金是最优的：一种新的跨期激励提供成本力量推动代理人报酬的前置。最优契约进入一个具有无限记忆的周期。不等贴现的引入使得标准的松弛问题方法在某些参数下失效。随后提供了一个简单且近似最优的契约。（JEL D21, D61, D82, D86, L14）

articles.title_en: Moral Hazard and Efficiency in a Frictional Market
articles.title_cn: 摩擦市场中的道德风险与效率
articles.abstract_en: Principals seek to trade with homogeneous agents by posting incentive contracts, which direct their search. Search and moral hazard interact in equilibrium. If using transfers to compensate agents failing to contract, the equilibrium allocation is always constrained-welfare-optimal in contrast to the one-to-one principal-agent problem. Search frictions thus correct that inefficiency because search requires internalizing the utility of agents. Incentives are weaker than in bilateral contracting, and agents enjoy more efficient risk sharing. With a constraint on transfers the allocation may become inefficient; principal competition results in overinsurance of the agents, too little effort in equilibrium, and excessive entry by principals. (JEL D82, D83, D86)
articles.abstract_cn: 委托人通过发布激励合同来寻求与同质代理人交易，这些合同引导着他们的搜索。搜索与道德风险在均衡中相互作用。如果使用转移支付来补偿未能签约的代理人，均衡配置总是受约束的福利最优，这与一对一的委托-代理问题形成对比。因此，搜索摩擦纠正了这种无效率，因为搜索要求内化代理人的效用。激励比双边缔约时更弱，代理人享受更有效的风险分担。在转移支付受限的情况下，配置可能变得无效率；委托人竞争导致对代理人的过度保险、均衡中的努力不足以及委托人的过度进入。（JEL D82, D83, D86）
